role: W7/W8 — one canonical load basis per check (ASD/LRFD, wind pressure basis, load combination, zone pressure, adjustments); the 3.0× band is retired for separate closure/envelope/lost-load/duplicate-area/count checks.

env.windSpeedSource: code-minimum default (ASCE 7-22 §26.5) — UNVERIFIED, no AHJ wind authority

provenance.note: wind/snow/exposure from canonical site → structural-engine-v4; ASCE edition via code-authority interface (AHJ population = W4)

checks.name: attachment-count-vs-reaction-model
checks.basis: canonical attachment objects === engine calcMountLayout mountCount (per-attachment reaction basis)

checks.name: tributary-lost-load-floor
checks.basis: lost-load prevention: Σ attachment.tributaryAreaFt2 must COVER the module footprint (Σ ≥ array area). The uniform CONSERVATIVE SCREENING ENVELOPE charges a full interior tributary at every mount, so Σ ≥ area is intentional.

checks.name: tributary-duplicate-area-guard
checks.basis: duplicate-area prevention: Σ tributary ≤ 2.05× array area. The screening envelope's end-mount overcount tops out at the all-end-mount 2× degenerate; a ratio above that signals duplicated attachment objects, not conservatism.

checks.name: uplift-reactions-vs-applied
checks.basis: Σ upliftReactionLbs envelopes 0.6·(net C&C uplift psf) × array area (screening envelope: ≥ applied, ≤ 2×)

checks.name: dead-reactions-vs-applied
checks.basis: Σ deadReactionLbs envelopes added dead-load psf × array area (screening envelope: ≥ applied, ≤ 2×)

reactionReconciliation.note: Reactions reconcile under the CONSERVATIVE SCREENING ENVELOPE: 64 attachments, Σ design tributary 704 ft² covers the array footprint 636.461 ft² (×1.106). This is NOT an exact geometric closure: every mount — end mounts included — is charged a FULL interior tributary, so Σ ≥ area is intentional and documented. Validated by separate checks (lost-load floor Σ ≥ area; duplicate-area guard Σ ≤ 2.05× area; per-limit-state reaction envelope; object-count agreement) — not a single loose band.
